chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Abū Ayyūb al-Khazzāz, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

“Indeed, in the Book of ʿAlī عليه السلام it is stated that he used to strike with the whip, with half of the whip, and with part of it in the prescribed punishments. And when a boy and a girl who had not yet reached maturity were brought, he would strike them and would not invalidate any prescribed punishment from the punishments of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.”

It was said to him: “And how did he strike?” He said: “He would take the whip in his hand from its middle or from one-third of it, then strike with it according to the measure of their ages, and he would not invalidate any prescribed punishment from the punishments of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.”

key_terms.أَسْنَانِهِمْ: Their ages, used here as the measure for the manner of striking.
key_terms.السَّوْطِ: The whip used in carrying out corporal punishment.
key_terms.جَارِيَةٍ: A young female slave-girl or girl, here referring to an immature female.
key_terms.حَدًّا: A prescribed legal punishment established by Allah.
key_terms.غُلَامٍ: A boy not yet fully mature.
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: The written legal record attributed to Imām ʿAlī عليه السلام.

ai.seo_question: How does the Book of ʿAlī عليه السلام describe administering hadd punishments to minors?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal practice recorded in the Book of ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding the implementation of prescribed punishments. It describes a mitigated form of striking for those who had not reached maturity, while maintaining that the divinely prescribed hadd was not to be annulled.
